title: Someone else's mix in my wedge

complaints.says: I'm hearing the bass player's voice in my wedge, not mine.

win.label: Bass player's vocal out of Wedge 3

hints: The mix sounds right on the mixer. So which mix actually comes out of the stagebox output for Wedge 3?
cause: The mixer's output patch had Mix 3 and Mix 4 swapped, so the keys and bass wedges got each other's mixes.
lesson: Wedge mixes are routed to stagebox outputs in the mixer's output patch. If a wedge has the wrong mix, check the patch before re-doing the mix.
